rule: Founder, 26 November 2026: every visible system in the three target images is implemented as a functioning system, replaced by an approved equivalent, or recorded as an explicit owner-approved exception. No control is reproduced as decoration.

dispositions.implement: to be built as a working system
dispositions.equivalent: replaced by an equivalent the founder approved on 26 November 2026
dispositions.exception-asked: an exception asked of the founder, not yet answered

items.shows: Treasury, food, water, timber, stone, population, happiness, trade income a month
items.mustDo: Every figure is the simulation's own, with what moves it one click away
items.todayNote: Money, food-days, households, welfare, pool, store, timber and stone are shown with a forecast; no trade income, no population beyond households

items.shows: Season, year and 'Harvest season, winter approaching'; pause, play, fast, settings
items.mustDo: The calendar drives crops, water, prices and risk; speeds change nothing but time
items.todayNote: Seasons, days and three speeds exist; no settings panel

items.shows: Overview, Economy, Agriculture, Construction, Diplomacy, Defense
items.mustDo: Each opens a working view of that system
items.todayNote: Fields, works and market tabs exist; no overview, diplomacy or defence
items.needs: Diplomacy and defence need historical review

items.shows: First-Person
items.mustDo: Walk the valley: collision, stairs, bridges, doors, safe return, no change to the game
items.needs: Founder: required before Granada is called complete; no placeholder button until it works

items.shows: Photo Mode
items.mustDo: Hide the interface, move and focus the camera, preview time and weather, capture, change nothing
items.needs: Founder: required for the first production release

items.shows: Current objectives: feed the kingdom, water for three settlements, the merchants of Malaga, a difficult decision; quest journal
items.mustDo: Objectives count real state; a decision has real, different consequences; a journal keeps them
items.todayNote: Five quests that count real state; no journal, no decision with a cost on each side

items.shows: The Alhambra as a royal palace on its hill, labelled
items.mustDo: A place in the world with a role in the game, drawn from the museum's records
items.todayNote: A small hill town stands in the distance; the museum's records of the Alhambra are linked from the brief
items.needs: Its look needs review: nothing about its architecture may be stated as fact unreviewed

items.shows: Granada the capital, dense with houses, a market, walls and a river
items.mustDo: A town that grows with housing built and is where people live, trade and work
items.todayNote: A village of tiled houses, a mosque, a mill and a bridge, built by code; one authored building

items.shows: Malaga and Almeria as trade ports, with routes and a ship
items.mustDo: Ports that buy and sell at their own prices; goods travel and take time and cost
items.todayNote: The rules have markets with their own purses and the real distances; the game shows one market and no route

items.shows: Resource sites marked on the land: vines, olives, wheat, a mine
items.mustDo: Each is a working estate or site that can be opened and managed
items.todayNote: Fields of wheat, olives and a meadow can be opened; no vines, no mine

items.shows: A watermill with a turning wheel, people harvesting, ox-carts, guards, banners, a waterfall
items.mustDo: Movement that follows the simulation: the wheel with the water, carts with shipments, workers with work
items.todayNote: The wheel turns with the water; walkers and two carts exist and an outside reviewer could not make them out

items.shows: Snow mountains, terraces, orchards in autumn colour, a river valley
items.mustDo: Land, water and seasons that are the simulation's own state made visible
items.todayNote: A generated valley with four seasons of light and leaf, rain, snow on the range

items.shows: An olive estate: ready to harvest, workers, irrigation, expected harvest, storage free, value; Harvest, Manage, Details
items.mustDo: Open any estate; every figure is real; harvest and manage act on it
items.todayNote: A field panel says what stands, what it needs and what a harvest will do

items.shows: A new royal castle under construction at 64%, with scaffolding, cranes and a green outline of a tower about to be placed
items.mustDo: Building takes time, workers and materials, is seen being built, and is placed by the player with a preview that refuses bad ground
items.todayNote: Works are ordered from a list and stand on fixed lots

items.shows: An alert: border tensions increasing
items.mustDo: Events are forecast, can be prepared for, and have consequences
items.todayNote: Weather is forecast; nothing else happens to the valley
items.needs: Historical review of every event family

items.shows: Kingdom security: defensive readiness, fortress condition, diplomatic status
items.mustDo: A strategic system the player can raise or neglect, with consequences; no battles
items.needs: Founder: Granada keeps defence and border readiness, strategic and historically reviewed

items.shows: Marketplace: wheat, olives, olive oil, silk, ceramics with stock, buy and sell prices, trend and demand
items.mustDo: Prices that move with stock and demand; buying and selling through the ledger
items.todayNote: One market with two prices and a purse of its own; fewer goods; no trend or demand shown

items.shows: A merchant contract with Malaga: quantity, days, revenue, costs, fees, net profit, the route; accept
items.mustDo: A contract reserves goods, settles once, and its sums are the ledger's
items.todayNote: Contracts exist and are tested in the rules; none is offered in the game

items.shows: An adviser's warning: protect winter reserves before exporting more grain
items.mustDo: Advice computed from the real forecast
items.todayNote: The top bar names the most pressing fact

items.shows: A regional map of the kingdom with Granada, Malaga, Almeria and a scale
items.mustDo: A map of the museum's places at their true distances, that can be used to plan and to travel
items.todayNote: The places and distances are in the rules

items.shows: Layers: economy, agriculture, infrastructure, diplomacy, defense
items.mustDo: Each layer shows that system's real state on the map

items.shows: A production chain: olive grove, oil press, olive oil, warehouse, export to Malaga
items.mustDo: Each step is a building that works, with stock moving between them
items.todayNote: One recipe, olives to oil, in the rules; not in the game

items.shows: A construction catalogue: housing, agriculture, industry, infrastructure, castle, culture, gardens; wall, tower, gate, courtyard, keep, palace wing, residence, reservoir
items.mustDo: Every item can be built, costs what it says, and does something
items.todayNote: Four works: a house, a granary, the repair, the extension
items.needs: Castle pieces: strategic and historically reviewed

items.shows: The season: crop productivity, water availability, food reserves, days to winter
items.mustDo: The season's real effects, in figures
items.todayNote: Season, weather ahead and reserves are shown

items.shows: The city named: Baghdad, capital of the Abbasid caliphate; a year in both calendars
items.mustDo: A real city at a stated time
items.todayNote: The game is a fictional district, and says so
items.needs: Every statement about Baghdad needs a museum record and a named reviewer; until then the district stays fictional and labelled

items.shows: Treasury, food, water, population, materials and knowledge, each with its rate
items.mustDo: Six stocks with flows the player can trace
items.todayNote: Treasury, grain, households, welfare, learning and water; no materials

items.shows: Pause, play, fast, a speed; settings; help
items.mustDo: Time that runs and can be stopped, with building and research taking time
items.todayNote: The game is played a season at a turn
items.needs: A change of the game's clock, taken from the image being binding

items.shows: Economy, Population, Research, Trade, Diplomacy
items.mustDo: Each opens a working view of that system
items.todayNote: Research and a ledger exist; trade is one line of income; no population or diplomacy view

items.shows: A whole river city: a great domed complex, houses to the horizon, walls, bridges
items.mustDo: A city of districts that the player grows
items.todayNote: One district of 48 plots

items.shows: Boats on the river, markets with awnings and crowds, carts and camels, smoke
items.mustDo: Movement that follows trade, population and work
items.todayNote: A few figures on the lanes

items.shows: A water wheel lifting water to fields
items.mustDo: Irrigation the player builds and that fails visibly when neglected
items.todayNote: Canals are dug link by link and water is seen to arrive; a wheel stands at the intake once researched

items.shows: A grand library complex being built: scaffolding, cranes, its ground marked out
items.mustDo: Building over time, placed by the player on marked ground
items.todayNote: A building appears at once on its plot

items.shows: Construction progress, workers assigned, materials delivered, days remaining
items.mustDo: The real state of the work

items.shows: An observatory with an armillary sphere
items.mustDo: A building that does something

items.shows: Research and development: the project in hand, its progress, months remaining
items.mustDo: Research that takes time and unlocks things
items.todayNote: Five projects, each linked to a museum record

items.shows: Development objectives: expand the scholarly district, attract scholars, an observatory and a paper mill, monthly income, welfare
items.mustDo: Objectives that count real state
items.todayNote: Goals for households, welfare, learning and endowments

items.shows: City overview: prosperity, citizen welfare, public health, education and culture, infrastructure, out of 100
items.mustDo: Five indices each explained by its causes
items.todayNote: Welfare is accounted for cause by cause; no other index

items.shows: A construction catalogue: infrastructure, scholarly district, economy, housing, public services
items.mustDo: Every item can be built and does something
items.todayNote: Nine kinds of building in one list

items.shows: A 'Military' category in the catalogue
items.needs: Founder: replaced by Civic Resilience (public safety, fire, flood, walls and gates where relevant, protection of works, emergency food and water, disease response, road safety, negotiated security); no combat units

items.shows: Library, translation house, manuscript workshop, observatory, madrasa, paper mill, scholars' residence, research hall
items.mustDo: Each a building with its own work
items.todayNote: A library, a school, a workshop among the nine
items.needs: Each needs a museum record behind it

items.shows: A small map of the city with layers and a locate button
items.mustDo: A map that is the city's real plan and moves the view

items.shows: Explore, Investigate, Locate, Date
items.mustDo: The steps of a round
items.todayNote: Locate, and an estimate of the century

items.shows: 'Compete'
items.needs: Founder: replaced by Challenge: personal bests kept on the device, practice and themed challenges, a result that can be copied, pass-and-play on one device; nothing implies scores are compared anywhere

items.shows: Daily Challenge and Practice Mode
items.mustDo: Two ways to play, kept apart
items.todayNote: Both exist

items.shows: An account icon
items.needs: Founder: replaced by a local profile with settings and accessibility; no accounts, no sign-in

items.shows: Round 3 of 5, with the rounds done ticked
items.mustDo: Progress through the day's five

items.shows: A photograph of the place, with zoom, full screen and a magnifier
items.mustDo: A picture the player studies, licensed and credited without giving the answer away
items.todayNote: Four of the museum's pictures qualify; a weekly picture round needs 52
items.needs: Pictures: the museum's media, the held V&A images

items.shows: Three historical clues, revealed in turn
items.mustDo: Clues from the museum's record of the thing, that narrow the answer fairly
items.todayNote: The clue is the record's name alone
items.needs: Clue text must come from museum records

items.shows: Relief, snow, rivers; clouds; night with city lights
items.mustDo: A globe that can be read as land
items.todayNote: Coastlines on a plain lit sphere, with a grid
items.needs: Public-domain data to be chosen and its licence checked; modern city lights must not give an answer away

items.shows: A compass; zoom controls; a pin
items.mustDo: Find north, zoom, place and move a pin
items.todayNote: Zoom and pin; no compass

items.shows: Terrain view: elevation, mountains, rivers
items.mustDo: Layers that change what the globe shows

items.shows: 'Political Borders'
items.todayNote: Left out on purpose
items.needs: Founder: no modern borders in an unanswered round; modern borders after the reveal; an optional borders hint with a stated cost; historical boundaries only where reviewed, tied to the period, and labelled approximate or disputed

items.shows: Historical overlays: the Islamic world c. 750 to 1250, al-Andalus c. 750 to 1492, trade routes, major cities
items.mustDo: Overlays tied to the period, from reviewed data
items.needs: Every boundary and route needs a museum record and a named reviewer

items.shows: A timeline from the 7th to the 16th century
items.mustDo: Choose the period; overlays follow it
items.todayNote: Earlier, no estimate, later

items.shows: Your score; the rounds before with their points
items.mustDo: The game's real arithmetic, visible while playing
items.todayNote: Points at each reveal and a summary at the end

items.shows: Hints left: reveal the region, eliminate a century, an extra clue
items.mustDo: Each costs what it says and helps as it says
items.todayNote: One hint, the region, at a stated cost

items.shows: Select the construction period, a century
items.mustDo: A second answer, scored
items.todayNote: An estimate of the century that is recorded and counted

items.shows: Submit guess
